question: India ranked ______ on the Global Hunger Index 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**102nd.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• India is ranked **102 of 117 countries** in the Global Hunger Index 2019.
 
• In the **2021 **Global Hunger Index, India ranks **101st out of 116 countries.**
 
• India** ranked 132 out of 191 countries** in the United Nations Human Development Index **2021-22 released on September 8, 2022.**
 
• In **2017**, India was **ranked at 100th position**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The global hunger index is a means of monitoring whether countries are** attaining hunger-related SDGs**. 
 
• A country's Global Hunger result is calculated by averaging the percentage of the population, which is **undernourished**, the number of **children younger than five years of age** who are **underweight**, and the number of children who **die before the age of five.​ **
